timeline.summary: Novartis India reported Q3FY25 revenue of ₹93 Cr (up 10% YoY) and PAT of ₹25.45 Cr (down 4.2% YoY) with EBITDA margin expanding to 27.51%
Novartis India received a service tax demand of ₹30.06 lakh for the period October 2014 to June 2017 and plans to file an appeal.
Novartis AG’s Stefan Thommen declares no encumbrance on its 17,450,680 Novartis India equity shares as of March 31, 2025, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Novartis India approved FY25 financial results with 6.3% revenue growth to ₹356.27 Cr and recommended ₹25 per share dividend.
Novartis India Ltd’s Board recommended ₹25 final dividend per share (₹5 face value) for FY2025, pending AGM approval.

Novartis India initiated e-ballot for shareholder approval of a ₹300 Cr related-party transaction with Novartis Pharma AG and re-appointment of an Independent Director, with voting open until 15 June 2025.

On 15 June 2025, Novartis India shareholders approved the re‑appointment of Independent Director Mr. Sanker Parameswaran and the ₹300 Cr related‑party transaction with Novartis Pharma AG via postal ballot.
Novartis India Ltd’s **Chandni Maru (ACS 60291)** announced final dividend of ₹25/share (FY2024-25) via email to shareholders, with TDS details, ahead of AGM on July 31, 2025.

Novartis India filed its FY25 annual report: unmodified audit opinion, ₹82.24 Cr of stock purchases from Novartis Pharma AG and ₹2.9 Cr royalty to the parent, with a clean balance sheet and no borrowings.
Novartis India reported Q1FY26 results with revenue down 5.1% YoY to ₹87.55 Cr and PAT up 7.3% YoY to ₹27.62 Cr
Q2FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹90.33 Cr (+3.7% YoY), net profit ₹24.22 Cr (+18.7% YoY).
Novartis India receives ₹30 Cr tax demand and penalty for FY15 CENVAT credit non-compliance, plans appeal
Novartis India reported Q3FY26 revenue down 7.6% YoY to ₹85.9 Cr and PAT down 36.8% to ₹16.09 Cr, hit by a ₹5.56 Cr prior-year tax adjustment and a ₹1.68 Cr labour-code provision.
2026-02-19: Novartis AG signs SPA to sell 70.68% stake in Novartis India to WaveRise, ChrysCapital, Two Infinity
Novartis AG agreed to sell its 70.68% stake in Novartis India Ltd to WaveRise, ChrysCapital and Two Infinity Partners on February 19, 2026.
Novartis India received public announcement of open offer at ₹860.64/share for 26% of voting capital following SPA for 70.68% stake sale to WaveRise, ChrysCapital and Two Infinity Partners

Novartis AG agreed to sell its 70.68% stake in Novartis India Ltd to WaveRise, ChrysCapital and Two Infinity Partners for ₹1,445.89 Cr on February 19, 2026, triggering a mandatory open offer for 26% at ₹860.64 per share.

Novartis India received the Detailed Public Statement dated February 26, 2026 for the open offer by WaveRise Investments, ChrysCapital Fund X and Two Infinity Partners for up to 26% at ₹860.64 per share.

Novartis India received the Detailed Public Statement dated February 25, 2026 for the open offer by WaveRise Investments, ChrysCapital Fund X and Two Infinity Partners for up to 26% at ₹860.64 per share.
Novartis India's manager to the open offer, Axis Capital, filed the draft letter of offer dated March 5, 2026 for the ₹552.50 Cr open offer at ₹860.64 per share.

Novartis India received the draft letter of offer dated March 5, 2026 from Axis Capital, manager to the ₹552.50 Cr open offer at ₹860.64 per share by WaveRise Investments, ChrysCapital Fund X and Two Infinity Partners.

Novartis India's board approved the appointment of Ms. Gowree Gokhale as an additional non-executive independent director for five years from April 1, 2026, and noted Ms. Sandra Martyres' cessation on April 18, 2026 after her second term.
Novartis India received a tax demand of ₹10.28 Cr for FY20 on March 26-27, 2026, relating to alleged TDS non-compliance on margin to stockist and interest on MSMEs
Novartis India received Delhi High Court order admitting its tax petition for FY 2013-14, with potential refund of ₹0.54 Cr if favorable

Novartis AG declared on April 7, 2026 that its 1,74,50,680 shares (70.68%) in Novartis India were unencumbered as on March 31, 2026, reiterating the February 19, 2026 SPA to sell the stake to WaveRise Investments, ChrysCapital Fund X and Two Infinity Partners.
Shareholders approved Ms. Gowree Gokhale’s appointment as Non-Executive Independent Director via postal ballot on May 16, 2026, with 99.97% votes in favor.
Axis Capital submitted Letter of Offer for open offer to acquire up to 26% of Novartis India from public shareholders at ₹860.64 per share.

Novartis India received the Letter of Offer dated June 1, 2026 from Axis Capital for the open offer by WaveRise Investments, ChrysCapital Fund X and Two Infinity Partners to acquire up to 64,19,608 shares (26%) at ₹860.64 per share, total ₹552.49 Cr.
Novartis India's open offer at ₹860.64 per share opened for tendering on June 11, 2026, with the IDC noting the market price of ₹1,351.20 was higher.
On June 15, 2026, zero equity shares were tendered in the open offer by WaveRise Investments, ChrysCapital Fund X and Two Infinity Partners for up to 64,19,608 shares at ₹860.64 per share.
Novartis India's open offer at ₹860.64 per share saw nil shares tendered on June 16, 2026, the second consecutive nil day, with the offer closing on June 24, 2026.

On June 18, 2026, Novartis India's open offer at ₹860.64 per share saw nil shares tendered in the demat escrow account and 10 shares in physical form, the third consecutive day of negligible tendering.
On June 22, 2026, nil equity shares were tendered in demat form and 10 shares in physical form in the open offer by WaveRise Investments, ChrysCapital Fund X and Two Infinity Partners.

On June 23, 2026, Novartis India's open offer at ₹860.64 per share saw nil shares tendered in the demat escrow account and 112 shares in physical form, the fourth consecutive day of negligible tendering, with the offer closing on June 24, 2026.

On June 24, 2026, Novartis India's open offer at ₹860.64 per share saw nil shares tendered in the demat escrow account and 182 shares in physical form, the fifth consecutive day of negligible tendering, with the offer closing on June 24, 2026.
On July 10, 2026, Novartis India submitted the post-offer advertisement confirming completion of the open offer with 40 shares tendered and accepted.
On July 23, 2026, Novartis India reported Q1FY27 revenue of ₹103.8 Cr (up 19% YoY) and PAT of ₹32.2 Cr (up 17% YoY), with one customer contributing ₹53.3 Cr of traded-goods revenue.
On July 23, 2026, Novartis India reported Q1FY27 revenue of ₹103.8 Cr (up 19% YoY) and PAT of ₹32.2 Cr (up 17% YoY), with EBITDA margin at 33.6%.

On July 29, 2026, Novartis India's board noted completion of the sale of 17,450,680 shares from Novartis AG to ChrysCapital entities, reclassified NAG from promoter to public, and appointed six new directors while recording six resignations.
On July 29, 2026, Novartis AG filed Form C disclosing the sale of 1,74,50,680 shares (70.68% of capital) for ₹13,76.9 Cr, taking its holding to nil.

On July 29, 2026, Novartis India's board appointed six additional directors (three non-executive non-independent, three independent) and recorded the resignations of six directors including Chairperson Christopher Snook, whole-time director Falin Majmudar and CFO Shilpa Joshi, as the NAG-to-ChrysCapital share sale and open offer closed.
On July 29, 2026, Novartis India completed sale of 17,450,680 shares to ChrysCapital entities, ending Novartis AG's promoter holding and appointing new management.
On August 07, 2026, Novartis India's board approved termination of distribution agreement with Dr. Reddy's Laboratories effective September 30, 2026, to re-acquire exclusivity for specified products.

On August 17, 2026, Novartis India's board proposed a change of company name (CRC-approved) and a new Memorandum of Association aligned to Companies Act Table A, both subject to shareholder approval at the 78th AGM, and amended that AGM's notice.
Novartis India published its FY26 annual report showing revenue of ₹354.3 Cr and PAT of ₹93.2 Cr.

On September 7, 2026, Novartis India's board approved and executed the acquisition of Minipress and Minipres trademarks and related IP in India from Pfizer Inc. USA and Pfizer Products Inc. USA for ₹1,250 Cr.

On September 8, 2026, Novartis India entered into an exclusive promotion and distribution agreement with Novartis Healthcare Private Limited for its retina portfolio (Accentrix® and Pagenax®) in India for an upfront consideration of ₹10 Cr.

Novartis India's September 11, 2026 investor presentation detailed the ₹1,250 Cr Minipress acquisition, a shift to an owned ~900-member field force, and flagged unquantified one-time transition costs in Q2-Q4 FY27.

On September 11, 2026, Novartis India held its first investor call after the ChrysCapital takeover, guiding to doubling revenue in four to five years from a ₹650 Cr FY27 run-rate while flagging ₹40-50 Cr per quarter of incremental transition cost.
On October 1, 2026, Novartis India Limited changed its name to Evonile Pharma Limited following shareholder approval at the September 24, 2026 AGM.
Evonile Pharma Ltd received CARE A; Stable long-term and CARE A2+ short-term ratings from CARE Ratings on October 7, 2026.
On October 8, 2026, Evonile Pharma approved a ₹900 Cr rights issue and constituted a Rights Issue Committee.
